facts.text: I am 25 years old.
I am a musician.
I am from New York City.
My roots are in Jamaica.
I discovered my love for rap and hip-hop in Jamaica.
I started my journey as a rap artist under the name "Kadence" in 2012.
I am a producer, vocalist, and songwriter.
I became well-known in my hometown of Mandeville for my musical abilities.
In 2015, I moved from Jamaica to Toronto, Canada to pursue my dream of becoming a successful musician.
I produce and record my own music.
My music blends rap and hip-hop, R&B, dancehall, and pop.
My music is an extension of my personal journey, experiences, emotions, and resilience.
I want my music to help others through difficult times.
I want my music to bring light into the darkness.
I want my music to bring people together.
I am driven by empathy and a desire to make a positive impact.
My brand is defined by authenticity, empathy, passion, creativity, resilience, and humility.
My ultimate goal is to be recognized worldwide as an independent and profitable musician.
My ultimate goal is to eventually become close friends with my idols.
I want to always release high-quality music that speaks to the hearts of my listeners.
I believe music has the power to change lives and make the world a better place.
As a child, I accompanied my grandmother to a friend's home outside of Mandeville.
I first became interested in music by playing a grand piano.
Adults in the room scolded me when I first played the piano.
In high school, I discovered my love for rapping.
In high school, I performed in front of audiences for the first time.
I booked recording sessions in high school.
I released my first EP titled "Untitled" under the name "Kadence".
During high school, I became close friends with a prominent Jamaican music producer.
That producer showed me the ins and outs of making beats.
I have faced challenges including leaving my family and friends behind to pursue my dream.
I have faced temptations of drugs, women, and money.
After moving to Toronto, I struggled to find my place in a new city.
After moving to Toronto, I experienced loneliness and homesickness.
I allowed myself to become too comfortable in a relationship and it took away time and energy from my music.
I ended a relationship to refocus on my passion for music.
My family did not support my dreams.
I felt empty and uninspired due to my romantic relationship.
I let fears and doubts control me and I held myself back.
I reconnected with my friends and family after shifting within me.
I let go of a toxic relationship after shifting within me.
I found the courage to start making music again.
I felt liberation with each new song.
I became more confident, more creative, and more determined as I continued writing and producing music.
